Chapter III — Process
From brief to placed — three steps. Most placements confirmed within 48 hours.
Step 01
Tell us the role, schedule, cuisine direction, and household size. Takes five minutes on WhatsApp or the form below. The more specific, the better the match.
Step 02
Within 24 hours, we shortlist 2–3 vetted candidates from our active network. You review profiles, choose your top pick, and we arrange an in-person or video interview.
Step 03
Contract signed, onboarding handled, first-week check-in included. We stay in contact for the first month to make sure the match is working on both sides.

Chapter IV — Questions

Private chefs, live-in chefs, villa managers, butlers, housekeepers, waiters, event staff, and household managers. For hotels and restaurants we can build full-team briefs on request. How quickly can you fill a position? Most private chef placements are confirmed within 48 hours of receiving a brief. For live-in arrangements or management roles, allow 3–5 days for profiling and a trial session. Urgent requests: message Marco directly on WhatsApp. What if the staff member is not the right fit? Every placement includes a 30-day trial period. If the match is not working — for any reason — we replace at no charge. We maintain a bench of vetted backup candidates for every active placement. Do you handle contracts and payroll? Yes. We provide standard Indonesian staffing contracts and payroll guidance. For long-term or full-team placements, we can advise on employment compliance and household structure. All included in the placement fee. What does it cost? Private chef placement starts from IDR 5,500,000/month (part-time) and IDR 9,500,000/month (full-time). Our placement fee is one month's salary, which covers sourcing, vetting, trials, contract, and six months of ongoing support. Villa & household staff pricing is quoted per role.
